title: Confirm the dinner venue to guests
ask: Draft the note to guests confirming the anniversary dinner. The venue answered my question about the room in venue-reply.md; check what they say about how many it seats.
background: We have 110 acceptances, and I'm hoping the Garden Room takes all of them at one sitting.
The dinner is on Saturday 18 April at 7.

start.venue-reply.md:
From: events@harbourview-hall.example

Thank you for your enquiry about Saturday 18 April.
The Garden Room seats 80 for a seated dinner.
The room is available from 6 until midnight.
